# Set 'N Concrete

> A concrete and roofing contractor serving Southwestern Pennsylvania. One company handles
> excavation, concrete, decorative concrete, epoxy flooring, retaining walls and roof
> replacement — "One Company. Every Solution. From the ground to the roof, we do it all."

## Contact

- Phone (call or text): 412-439-8833
- Estimates: free, written, no obligation
- Service area: Southwestern Pennsylvania — Allegheny, Washington, Westmoreland, Butler,
  Beaver, Armstrong, Fayette and Greene counties, including Pittsburgh, Monroeville,
  Cranberry Township, Canonsburg, McMurray, Greensburg, Bethel Park and Uniontown.
- Website: https://setnconcrete.com/

## Services

- **Concrete** — driveways, aprons, patios, walkways, sidewalks, steps, and garage, shed and
  pole-barn slabs. Built with compacted sub-base, correct slab thickness and control joints
  cut for Western Pennsylvania freeze-thaw cycles.
- **Decorative concrete** — stamped patterns, integral and broadcast dyes, swirl and broom
  finishes, decorative borders and sealing.
- **Excavation** — site prep and clearing, grading, drainage correction, footer/trench/utility
  digging, demolition and haul-away. Equipment is owned and operated in-house.
- **Epoxy flooring** — mechanically ground, chip-broadcast epoxy coatings for garages,
  basements, workshops and commercial floors; resistant to road salt, hot tires and staining.
- **Roofing** — architectural shingle and standing-seam metal roof replacements, full
  tear-offs, plus flashing, valleys and ventilation.
- **Retaining walls** — segmental block walls, terracing and grade changes, drainage stone and
  pipe, and rebuilds of failing walls.

## Key facts

- Six trades under one company, so excavation, concrete and roofing share one crew, one
  schedule and one point of contact.
- All estimates are free and provided in writing after an on-site visit.
- Process: call or text → free on-site estimate → prep and build → final walkthrough.
